contexts.text: Strength is attributed to Truth because it cannot be resisted.
The Lord had no strength from the Angels.
Strength, and arm () = power.
Strength () is predicated of truth.
That strength is in the Knowledges of truth. Signified.
Strength, etc. () is significative of the power of truth.
Strength is predicated of truth and of falsity.
To be renewed with strength () = to increase as to the willing of good.
The truths of the Church are called the strength of the mountains () from the power from good.
As Zion = the Celestial Church... and the Celestial Church is that which is in good from love to the Lord... therefore strength is predicated of().
The staff of strength () = power from good.
(Thus) the arms = strength; and the hand, power.
To strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh () = to trust in scientifics in the Things of faith.
The evil of the love of self is described by... the strength of the oak ().
Thou art my strength () = that through faith in the understanding good has power. AE 434:17.
Jehovah giveth strength to the weary, and to him that hath no forces He multiplieth power (). Here, strength is predicated of good; forces, of truth; and power, of both.
In strength of hand Jehovah lath brought you forth () = that they have been delivered by the Lord's Divine power. Strength of hand = power; and, when said of Jehovah, omnipotence. AC 8069. AC 8084.
Thy right hand, Jehovah, was magnified in strength () = that the Lord's omnipotence had been shown.
To praise in the expanse of strength () = from the good of charity from the Lord.
The strength of power then. Signified.
To love the Lord with all the strength = (with the) things which proceed from the life of love, thus from the heart, or will.
They are more robust in body.

The Cogitative of man from his Voluntary makes all the strength of the body, and if this were inspired by the Lord from His Divine truth, the man would have the strength of Samson; but it is the Lord's good pleasure that man should have strength through faith from love as to those things which are of his spirit.
No strength in the war () = not any resistance against evil and falsity.
To Him be glory and strength for ever and ever () = who alone has Divine majesty and Divine omnipotence to eternity. AR 291. AE 346.
Give ye strength unto God, strength upon the clouds ()... strength = the Divine power of the Word.
Honour, virtue, and strength, in the Word, where the Lord is treated of, are said of the Divine Celestial...
A strong Angel took up () = a strong influx of the Lord out of Heaven.
Strength = Divine good through Divine truth; for Divine good has all strength and all power through Divine truth.
Strength and beauty are in His sanctuary () = Divine good and Divine truth in the Church.
Strength, in the Word, is said of the power of good.
In horns is the hiding of His strength () = the omnipotence of Divine good through Divine truth; for all the power of good is through truth...
Jehovah is my strength (). Strength, when predicated of the Lord, = omnipotence.
His Divine power from which He fought is signified by marching in the multitude of His strength ().
Strength is said of the power and abundance of truth from good.
Strong () = its derivative quality as to the power of resisting falsities and evils.
Men of strength () = those who are clever, and seem to themselves to be intelligent.
Until his strength faileth () = until there is nothing of good left.
Pride of strength, strength, and power () are said of truths from good, because these have all strength and all power.
And power and strength () = omnipotence from Divine good through Divine truth... Power is said of Divine truth, and strength, of Divine good.

The strong one shall be as tow ()... The strong one and his work = what is hatched from Own intelligence. Strong, in the Word, is said of him who trusts in himself and in his own intelligence; for he believes himself and his work to be strong.
For all the strength and all the power of Divine truth... consists in its ultimate...
Men of strength to mingle strong drink () = those who falsify the truth of the Word.
As all power is of truth from good, they are called pillars of strength ().
I am become as a man that hath no strength () = that He then seemed to Himself to be devoid of power; for temptations immerse man in falsities and evils, in which there is no power.
Strength () = the power of good over evil; and horn, the power of truth over falsity.
To be girded with strength () = that such have truths from good and the derivative power.
From the power of the Word against falsities and evils... it is called the magnificence of the strength of Jehovah ().
The staff of strength is broken, the staff of beauty () = that they have no Divine truth in its power. The staff of strength = Divine truth in the natural sense...
(Hence) those in falsities are called the strong, etc.
The strength itself of the Divine power consists in ultima tea...
The strength which He gave into captivity () = spiritual truth from celestial good shut out from being understood.
Strength () = truth, because all spiritual strength consists in truths.
Put on thy strength, Zion () = (the truth of the Church which is in the good of love to the Lord, which is the truth from that good). AE 850:14.
The sceptre of strength out of Zion () = Divine truth which has omnipotence.
Zion is here called the king's strength () from Divine truth which has power itself.

He hath prostrated all my strong ones in the midst of me () = that all the power of truth against falsities has perished. ( = the destruction of the love of good; those in the love of good being called in the Word the strong, because good, from its love, is mighty against the Hells, and is therefore strong. AE 922:2.)
As, in the Word in the letter, there is all strength, it is said, marching in the multitude of His strength.
